segments.name: Metal components
segments.description: Produces metal components and value-added manufacturing solutions, from prototyping and tooling to coating and assembly, for OEM customers across diverse end markets.
segments.evidence: Our one operating segment focuses on producing metal components that are used in a broad range of heavy- and medium-duty commercial vehicles, construction & access equipment, powersports, data center & critical power, agricultural, military and other products.

revenueModel.text: OEM customers pay for value-added manufacturing solutions ranging from concept to production, including prototyping and tooling, production fabrication, coating, assembly and aftermarket components.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company derives revenue from its customers by providing value-added manufacturing solutions ranging from concept to production, including prototyping and tooling, production fabrication, coating, assembly and aftermarket components.
